title: feat(spec): object-grid declares description, emptyState (the list view's own shape) and keyboardNavigation
body:
Fixes #20694
Clause-②: yes

`ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']` (`ObjectGridPropsSchema`) gains the three members named in triage's direction (`5897622232`). This is a widening. Nothing that parsed before is refused, and the row still refuses every key it does not declare.

## What changes

- **`description`**: `I18nLabelSchema.optional()`. At the `.objectui-sha` pin `db11afd4967c`, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:5677` resolves it with `resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.description, displayLocale)` and draws it above the rows at `:5784`, `:6303` and `:6342`. The card calls the function `resolveI18nLabel`; at the pin it is named `resolveInlineI18nLabel`.
- **`emptyState`**: the list view's own empty-state shape, taken **by reference**. It used to be an inline `strictObject` at `ListViewShapeSchema.emptyState` (`view.zod.ts`). It is now the exported `EmptyStateSchema` (author type `EmptyState`), and `list-view` and `object-grid` both hold that one schema. At the pin it is read at `ObjectGrid.tsx:6225` and drawn through `DataEmptyState` at `:6233`.
- **`keyboardNavigation`**: `z.boolean().optional()`. Its describe is the one triage specified: arrow-key cell navigation on the WAI-ARIA grid pattern, on by default when `editable` is set, and a read-only grid keeps its Tab behaviour unless this is `true`. It is prefixed `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` because nothing reads it at the pin. Under objectui `packages/` and `apps/`, excluding tests, CHANGELOGs, READMEs and `packages/types` (which holds its type and zod twin), it has 0 hits; the control `schema.editable` has 3 hits in `ObjectGrid.tsx`.
- The block docblock records each key's read point at the pin, following its convention, and each member repeats its own.

### The extraction, and the one text change

- A parse corpus, run as a scratch script and not committed, covers 28 `emptyState` values on each of the four list-view doors: `ListViewSchema`, `ObjectListViewSchema`, `ViewSchema.list` and the flattened overlay arm of `ViewMetadataSchema`. That is 112 cells, compared between BASE `72f8c38201` and head.
  - `success` and parsed `data` are identical in 112 of 112 cells.
  - Issue codes, paths and keys are identical in 112 of 112 cells (every `message` field stripped at every depth).
  - After substituting only the guidance sentence, the full JSON of each result is byte-identical in 112 of 112 cells.
- The 12 cells that differ at all are the `action`, `button` and mixed inputs on each of the four doors. In those cells the `action`/`button` guidance is reworded so that it also reads true on `object-grid`, which has no `addRecord` block. It still points at `addRecord` (`view-strictness-batch18.test.ts` still passes), and it follows the `VIEW_ROW_BOUND_GUIDANCE` precedent for text that two doors share.
- The members gain short describes. The list view's reference docs lose the inherited sentence claiming the inline locale map is "resolved at render time"; see Acceptance note 1 for why that claim did not hold.

### Liveness record for `keyboardNavigation`

The liveness ledger has no row for any `ComponentPropsMap` key. The page ledger leaves `page/regions` undrilled (it is listed in `undrilled-containers.baseline.json`), and `PageComponent.properties` is an open record, so the walk never reaches `ObjectGridPropsSchema`; a row in `page.json` would be an orphan. The record is therefore the describe marker `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]`, which is the ledger's own spelling for a declared key that is not enforced (`MARKER_RE` in `check-liveness.mts`). The member docblock says to drop the marker in the change that lands the reader. `check:liveness` is green.

### Files outside the claimed surface

- `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`: `gen:docs` refuses to document a schema that has no type alias, so `EmptyState` is exported. ADR-0122 then requires an isomorphism pin (`Iso_ui_view__EmptyStateSchema`), which moves the pin count from 779 to 780. The schema's tree has no default and no transform, so a synonym `EmptyStateParsed` would be wrong.

## Evidence (head `98dad84e21`, which includes a merge of `origin/main` at `07356a6ab0` through `os-regen-merge.sh`)

- `object-grid` corpus: 3 of 36 cases parsed at BASE and 14 of 36 parse at head. The newly accepted cases are exactly the valid values of the three members, and no case is newly refused. Both `examples/app-showcase` `object-grid` nodes (command-center `cc_queue_g` and the my-work queue) parse before and after.
- **Pins:** `component-object-grid-declared-keys.pin.test.ts` passes 18 of 18. §1 checks that the three members parse byte-identically. §2 checks that an unknown top-level key is refused with `unrecognized_keys` at the row, and that a wrong value in each member is refused (code and path). §3 checks that the grid and the list view hold `EmptyStateSchema` by identity, and that the grid answers exactly what that schema answers.
- **Ablations**, run on the committed state through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - Renaming the `keyboardNavigation` member: 4 tests fail and 14 pass.
  - Replacing the grid's `EmptyStateSchema` with a copied `z.strictObject`: only the identity pin fails, and 17 pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 581 files, 17154 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. This includes `check:test-typecheck`, and the debt ledger is unchanged.
- **Consumer `@objectstack/lint`.** Its closure was built upstream with `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...'` (lint plus its dependencies).
  - Tests: 117 files, 5437 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
  - Component-props reading through `validateComponentProps` on an `object-grid` node:
    - The three keys produce 0 findings.
    - The control `emptyStat` produces `component-props-unknown-key` at `properties.emptyStat`.
    - The control `emptyState.heading` produces the same rule at `properties.emptyState.heading`. That path exists only through the new declaration, which shows the rule read the rebuilt dist.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 15 artifacts are up to date.
- **Derived gates** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 108 families, run at head): 104 exited 0. Four exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so they are **NOT MEASURED**:
  - `check:skill-examples`: the client SDK closure is not built.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt`: each needs the whole-repo package build that CI does.
  - Reconciled with `--ran`: all 108 accounted for, 104 run, 4 NOT MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

1. **objectui renderer gap: an inline locale map in `emptyState.title` or `.message`.** At the pin, `ObjectGrid` passes both to `DataEmptyState` unresolved (`:6241-6242`), unlike `description`. React throws on an object child, measured on react 19.2.8: "Objects are not valid as a React child". `ListView` guards with `typeof === 'string'` (`plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5112` and `:5114`), so a map there silently falls back to the default text. No producer in `examples/**` or `platform-objects` writes a map there; all of them use strings. So this is not filed here. **Carrier:** the objectui follow-up the seat files at ACCEPT, which lists the three keys in `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`. Its fix is one resolver, `resolveInlineI18nLabel`, applied at both renderers. Meanwhile the changeset tells authors to write strings on `object-grid`.
2. `origin/main` moved to `9905e61ca2` after the merge; #20868 edits `view.zod.ts` and `view.mdx`. A merge-tree probe from a bare clone with no merge driver shows a clean merge, and the hunks in both files are disjoint from this branch's. CI validates the merge ref.
3. The `object-grid` follow-up in objectui, per triage: after the release is installable, list `description`, `emptyState` and `keyboardNavigation` in `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` (the reverse direction of the parity gate).
